<!-- pr-reviewer: fb0faa9a8cf9ff9dd4bb874e5bab3f1404acd998 -->
**Needs changes before merge** (reviewed at the high tier: it shifts the posted burn Z and what the stock sim judges). Scope: only this PR's own commit `b0e121ce` (feat(edm): sinker electrode wear compensation in Z) on top of #1131; the stack below it (#551, #560, #1131) is not re-reviewed here.

## Why it cannot merge as it stands
1. **Based on an older #1131 head.** The branch carries #1131 at `ed6a1eb4`; #1131 is now `05a44be7` and has since reworked the condition table (#560: `Condition` moved to `crates/post/src/machine/edm_conditions.rs`, strict `CONDITION_KEYS`, kind-aware parsing, gap > 0, bounded sizes, id rule). A trial merge of the current #1131 into this head conflicts in `crates/post/src/machine/edm.rs`, `crates/post/src/machine/mod.rs` and `crates/app/tests/sinker_burn.rs`. This is real logic, not an append-only conflict: the `wear` field and `wear_rate_ok` must be re-applied inside `edm_conditions.rs`. Note that `CONDITION_KEYS` there is `["id","name","gap","wire_diameter","undersize","role","notes"]`, so as merged `wear` would be refused as an unknown key unless it is added, and it should be declared a **sinker-only** field (refused on a wire machine by name, like `undersize` is, instead of accepted and ignored as `crates/post/src/machine/edm.rs:326-336` does now).
2. **Conflicts with current main** (`upstream/main` d7e9a807): `crates/post/src/machine/edm.rs`, `crates/post/src/machine/mod.rs` (same area as above, since #551 is now on main) and `crates/ui/src/egui_app/panes.rs` (the `op_icon` match, as NeoTech already noted). Not merged or built against main for that reason.

## What looks good (the PR's own commit)
- Compensation can only deepen by the stated wear and never past the finished floor: `crates/motion/src/sinker_wear.rs` programs each layer tip at `(top - d) + gap - rate*d`, and every move is re-checked against `deepest_tip = floor + gap - rate*(top - floor)` (`burn_compensated`, the per-move `tip < deepest - ON_FLOOR` refusal). The worn face ends on the nominal floor (the pin shows `worn_tip` is the exact inverse). The electrode-length law reads the deeper compensated tip. All of #541's refusals still run first (`check(p)`).
- The sim sees the compensated burn: `stock_sim::plan_program` maps tips through `sinker_wear_op::judged` / `as_burned`; the path itself (and so the post) carries the deeper Z. If the work top does not resolve, it errors by name rather than guessing.
- Wear rate validation: finite, `0 <= r < 1`, by name, at `parse_mch` (`edm.rs:325-336`), `Edm::is_sane`, the op commands (`OpParams::named_refusal` in create/edit, ahead of the generic message), the project reader (`project/validate.rs`), and again inside the generator. Measured wear: both-or-neither, finite, positive depth, rate < 1. Layer step: positive finite, capped at 10 000 layers.
- Missing data: no rate and no layer step gives exactly #541's moves (pinned) plus the note `electrode wear: not compensated (no wear rate stated)`; no default ratio is shipped.
- Digests and stamp add bytes only when stated; project keys are additive and optional.
- No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic` outside tests in the new code; provenance lines present; new files under 400 lines.
- Golden: only the new `crates/app/tests/golden/sinker_wear_layers.cl` (tips 18.010 / 15.970 / 13.930); no existing golden or snapshot PNG changed, and the body explains it. No process files, `build.rs`, scripts, `.github` or dependency changes.

## Local results (head `fb0faa9a`, NOT merged with main/#1131-current, because of the conflicts above)
| check | result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --lib sinker` | 5 passed |
| `camcraft-app` `--test sinker_wear` | 6 passed |
| `--test sinker_burn` | 7 passed |
| `--test edm_conditions` | 6 passed |
| `--test coarse_laws` | 6 passed (the inherited failure is fixed) |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

ui, tools and the other suites were not re-run (they pass per the author's gate; this head does not build against current main anyway).

## Requested before merge
1. Merge current `#1131` (`05a44be7`) into this branch, then `upstream/main`, and re-apply `wear` on the reworked table: add the field to `Condition` in `crates/post/src/machine/edm_conditions.rs`, add `"wear"` to `CONDITION_KEYS`, parse it there with the same `0 <= r < 1` law, and refuse it on a wire machine by name (a sinker-only field, like `undersize`); keep `Edm::fits`/`conditions_sane` kind-aware. Update `crates/app/tests/edm_conditions.rs` and `edm_machine.rs` accordingly (a wire machine stating `wear`, an out-of-range rate, `wear` as a non-number).
2. Resolve `crates/ui/src/egui_app/panes.rs` against main's `op_icon` rows, and `crates/app/tests/sinker_burn.rs` (keep both sides: the three new `None` fields and #1131's changes).
3. Re-run the targeted gate on the merged head (`sinker_wear`, `sinker_burn`, `edm_conditions`, `edm_machine`, `coarse_laws`, `golden_cl`, `project_roundtrip`, ui lib) and clippy, then flag ready again. Per the draft law this PR goes back to draft meanwhile.

## Questions / notes (not blocking)
- Posted-G-code change: the deeper Z is not Hub-simulated or run on a real control (and no sinker post exists yet, #542); the body states this honestly. Rates are user data, so a wrong stated rate over- or under-burns by `(stated - true) * depth` and the stock sim cannot show that, because it judges the worn electrode at the stated rate. A line in the decision file saying so would help.
- The rate is defined per mm of cavity depth below the work top (programmed `r*d` deeper), not per mm of tip travel; the docs and `worn_tip` agree with each other, but users reading a manual's "wear ratio" should be told which one this is on the page.
- Fork synced at v0.18.0; #1136 (#543) edits the same sinker files, as the author noted.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
